newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek tugs tow powerless ship with illegal aliens.
newsitem.headline: Greek tugs tow powerless ship with illegal aliens.

text.p: A Ukrainian-registered motorship thought to be carrying hundreds of illegal immigrants suffered power failure in Greek waters and was being towed to port by the coast guard, the Merchant Marine Ministry said on Wednesday.
The ship was drifting off the Aegean island of Andros with fires burning in barrels on its deck when it was spotted by Greek coast guard vessels at dawn, ministry officials said.
"It had a total black-out. Coast guard officials said they saw about 200 to 300 people on board and they think they are illegal immigrants," a ministry official told Reuters.
He said tug boats were towing the ship to the port of Lavrion near Athens, where a team of investigators was waiting to go aboard to assess the situation.
